primary_boundary: Resident START through safe RETURN_CPU and token copy, including empty-cache prefill and all required metadata, transfers, model work and delivery. Provisioning and independent checks excluded and separately retained.
checks: Original full-model prompts; exact IDs, complete final logits and valid KV, five original story-prefill traces, overflow non-mutation/recovery, safe release/reopen and normal helper unload.
scope: Final bounded 2/1/1 qualification after three optimization cycles; not endurance, tail or long-context performance. Seeded warmup+3 are measured separately.
